lines.text: Many learners say: I eated rice for lunch.
Better: I ate rice for lunch.

native.tip: eat의 과거형은 ate! “I ate rice for lunch”예요.
native.caption: “I eated rice for lunch”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 eat은 불규칙 동사라서 -ed 대신 ate로 바뀌어요. “I ate rice for lunch”가 맞아요. Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: The past of eat is ate. Say “I ate rice for lunch”.
en.caption: Do you say “I eated rice for lunch”? 😅 Eat is irregular, so the past is “ate”, not “eated”. “I ate rice for lunch” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
